claims.statement: Cedar Bluff Logistics Center is identified as the largest asset in the comparable set, at 412,000 square feet.

citations.quote: Cedar Bluff Logistics Center, the largest asset in the comparable set at 412,000 square feet, closed in May 2025, reflecting continued investor appetite for last-mile industrial product within the corridor.

claims.statement: The Comps worksheet data confirms Cedar Bluff Logistics Center at 412,000 square feet, which is larger than any other property listed in that comparable set (e.g., Fenwick Distribution Hub at 356,800 SF, Thornfield Industrial Park at 289,500 SF, Aurelia Corporate Campus at 205,000 SF, Cobalt Harbor Mixed-Use at 174,200 SF, Northgate Business Park at 148,500 SF, Wrenfield Business Center at 133,700 SF, Ridgeline Office Commons at 121,600 SF, Meridian Holdings Plaza at 92,300 SF, and Sablewood Retail Court at 68,400 SF).
